``` {r library, include = TRUE}
library(zellkonverter) ## for read in h5 files
library(Seurat)
library(biomaRt)
library(MAST)
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(reshape2)
library(stringr)
library(xlsx)
```
```{r data, include = TRUE, echo= TRUE, eval = FALSE}
data <-
  readH5AD("/mnt/run/jh/projects/obesity_sc/output/h5ad/ad_v3.h5ad", reader = "python")

data.seurat <- as.Seurat(data, counts = 'raw', data = 'log_norm')
saveRDS(data.seurat, "../output/10x_h5/h5ad/ad_v2.rds")

Idents(data.seurat) <- data.seurat@meta.data$subset_combined
## subset ctb and stb cells
ctb_stb <- subset(data.seurat, idents = c("CTB", "STB"))

ctb_stb_ctl <-
    ctb_stb[,ctb_stb@meta.data$group=="Normal_AGA"]
## filter genes less than 10%
ctb_stb_ctl <- subset(ctb_stb_ctl, features = rownames(ctb_stb_ctl)[Matrix::rowSums(ctb_stb_ctl@assays$originalexp@counts > 0) > 0.1 * ncol(ctb_stb_ctl)])

## find all markers and plot top ten genes heatmap
chrX <- unique(read.csv("/mnt/run/jh/projects/pcos_sc/data/chrX_genenames.txt", sep = "\t", header = T)["Gene.name"])
chrY <- unique(read.csv("/mnt/run/jh/projects/pcos_sc/data/chrY_genenames.txt", sep = "\t", header = T)["Gene.name"])
## remove chrX and chrY genes
ctb_stb_ctl_auto <- subset(ctb_stb_ctl, features = rownames(ctb_stb_ctl)[!rownames(ctb_stb_ctl) %in% chrX$Gene.name & !rownames(ctb_stb_ctl) %in% chrY$Gene.name])
## random sample STB to 1288 cells
stb_cells <- WhichCells(ctb_stb_ctl_auto, idents = "STB")
if (length(stb_cells) < 1288) {
  warning(sprintf("STB has only %d cells; keeping all of them.", length(stb_cells)))
  stb_keep <- stb_cells
} else {
  stb_keep <- sample(stb_cells, size = 1288, replace = FALSE)
}

other_cells <- setdiff(Cells(ctb_stb_ctl_auto), stb_cells)
ctb_stb_ctl_auto <- subset(ctb_stb_ctl_auto, cells = c(other_cells, stb_keep))
Idents(ctb_stb_ctl_auto) <- ctb_stb_ctl_auto@meta.data$subset_combined
all.markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  ctb_stb_ctl_auto,
  test.use = "MAST",
  slot = "data",
  logfc.threshold = 1,
  only.pos = TRUE,
  random.seed = 404,
  min.diff.pct = 0.1,
  return.thresh = 0.05,
)

## write out to excel
write.xlsx(all.markers, "/mnt/run/jh/projects/obesity_sc/output/degs/STB_CTB_DEGs_nosex.xlsx")
```

```{r export, include = TRUE, echo= TRUE, eval = FALSE}

obj <- ctb_stb_ctl_auto

# Get raw counts
counts <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = DefaultAssay(obj), slot = "counts")

# Rename columns to Idents (CTB/STB), allowing duplicate column names
idents <- as.character(Idents(obj)[colnames(counts)])
colnames(counts) <- idents

# Build export with first column 'Genes' and all sample (cell) columns
export_df <- data.frame(
  Genes = rownames(counts),
  as.matrix(counts),
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Write CSV (rows = 4708 genes, columns = 1+2576 [Genes + samples])
outfile <- "/mnt/run/jh/projects/obesity_sc/output/degs/ctb_stb_counts_by_ident.tsv"
write.table(export_df, outfile, row.names = TRUE, sep = "\t")
```

## filter
```{r filter, include = TRUE, echo= TRUE, eval = FALSE}
counts <- read.csv("/mnt/run/jh/projects/obesity_sc/output/degs/ctb_stb_counts_by_ident.tsv", sep = "\t", row.names = 1)
degs <- read.xlsx("/mnt/run/jh/projects/obesity_sc/output/degs/STB_CTB_DEGs_nosex.xlsx", sheetIndex = 1)
degs_counts <- counts[rownames(counts) %in% unlist(degs["NA."]), ]
names(degs_counts) <- sub("\\..*$", "", names(degs_counts))
write.table(degs_counts, "/mnt/run/jh/projects/obesity_sc/output/degs/degs_counts.tsv", sep = "\t", row.names = F)
```
